outcome: anemia near delivery (hemoglobin <110 g/L within 30 days of delivery)
cohort: The study included 51,782 pregnant persons delivering from January 2012 through December 2022 at two large academic centers.
finding: Approximately 30% of all patients were anemic near delivery, with those in the lowest income quintile being 18% more likely to be anemic than those in the highest income quintile.
mod_finding: The majority (61%) of pregnancies in the study cohort were delivered vaginally.
